problem:
The rate $O$ of the orders a car factory receives can be modeled as $O(t)=100t{e}^{-0.1t}$ cars per day. The rate at which cars are completed can be modeled as $C(t)=50+10sin⁡(\frac{2\pi }{7}t)$ cars per day. In both cases, $t$ is the time, in days, since the launch of the new model. 

What is the rate of change in the number of cars under construction $28$ days after the model's launch? Assume that an ordered car goes into construction as soon as the factory receives its order. Round your answer to the nearest integer.
